title: Ridgeline Installation Services Change Order Administration Fee — Charge Line and Tool
content:
Ridgeline Installation Services charges a change order administration fee for a signed change order that increases the contract price. The fee is charged for the most recent change order billed on the contract.

## The fee line

- The change order administration fee posts as one administration fee line on the contract, referencing the change order request it arises from, at the amount the change order administration fee rule fixes.
- The change order request is the request on which the customer's change to the scope was registered and priced by the installer.
- Once posted, the fee appears on the contract's statement of charges and the contract's balance due rises by the fee.

## Invocation

The fee is posted with the agent-side tool `post_change_order_fee_b62b1022`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; one call adds one administration fee line, dated the day it is posted and tied to the change order request.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_contract_id` | the reference number of the installation contract the fee is charged on, as returned by the installation contract lookup for the customer | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `install_request_id` | the reference number of the change order request the fee arises from, as returned by the installation service request lookup for that contract | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `fee_amount` | the administration fee, in USD | a positive amount written to 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half to even to the cent when it is recorded |

## Return

A receipt with `install_charge_id` (the reference number of the new fee line), `install_contract_id` (the contract charged), `contract_number` (the contract number exactly as on the contract), `fee_type` (always `change_order_admin_fee`), `amount` (the fee posted, in USD to 2 decimal places), `charge_date` (today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the contract's balance due after the fee, in USD to 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying an `install_charge_id` means the fee is on the contract.
